content.title: <RichColor Color="0.85,0.05,0.05,1">Welcome to Khaos Nexus</>
content.text:
Khaos Nexus is a community-focused ARK: Survival Ascended cluster built around long-term progression, quality-of-life improvements, events, rewards, and a growing connected server network.

Current server: Khaos Nexus (Gen1) — Genesis Part 1

Survive. Build. Conquer. Create chaos responsibly.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.85,0.05,0.05,1">Server Information</>
content.text:
Khaos Nexus uses a curated quality-of-life setup designed to reduce unnecessary grind while keeping meaningful ARK progression.

Expect improved breeding, storage, travel, crafting, building, dino utility, custom rewards, and an in-game shop as cluster services come online.

Major balance changes, maintenance, events, and new maps are announced through Khaos Nexus.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.85,0.05,0.05,1">Progression & Breeding</>
content.text:
XP category multipliers: 1x
Egg Hatch Speed: 20x
Baby Mature Speed: 15x
Crop Growth Speed: 8x

Rates may be adjusted for events or balance updates.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.85,0.05,0.05,1">Player Stat Gains</>
content.text:
Health: 2.5x
Stamina: 2x
Weight: 5x
Movement Speed: 2x
Fortitude: 5x

These are per-level player stat multipliers. Unlisted player stats remain at their current server values.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.85,0.05,0.05,1">Community Rules</>
content.text:
1. Respect players and staff.

2. No cheating, meshing, duping, exploit abuse, or knowingly using bugs for an unfair advantage.

3. Do not intentionally cause server instability or excessive performance problems.

4. Do not impersonate staff.

5. Follow staff instructions during incidents, events, maintenance, and investigations.

6. Report serious bugs and exploits instead of spreading or abusing them.

7. Use Nexus support for disputes and server issues whenever possible.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.85,0.05,0.05,1">Nexus Shop</>
content.text: Khaos Nexus uses the MX-E Ark Shop UI in-game. ASA ArkShop and Nexus Sentinel integration are being brought online for points, kits, rewards, and centrally managed listings across Nexus maps.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.85,0.05,0.05,1">Connected Nexus</>
content.text:
Genesis Part 1 is the first active Khaos Nexus map. Additional maps will be added as the community and infrastructure grow.

Permissions, shop data, server status, events, administration, and player-facing information are being designed as shared cluster services managed through Nexus Sentinel.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.85,0.05,0.05,1">Need Help?</>
content.text:
For server problems, missing items, mod issues, transfer problems, suspected exploits, or staff assistance, contact Khaos Nexus staff through Discord.

Include the map, character or tribe name, approximate time, what happened, and screenshots or video when available.
